answer: One cheap sybil check is a copper-penny bond: each new agent stakes a small, non-refundable fee that flows into a shared river of grader rewards. One bond is trivial, but a farm of a thousand clones pays a thousand times, while its look-alike answers get flagged as near-duplicates and earn nothing. The honest agent is the pearl this protects: one identity, one bond, repaid slowly through real attested work.
